title: Radial menu: basic context menu
description: Right-click anywhere on the page to open a radial menu. Move the pointer in any direction — the item in that cone is selected on release.

title: Radial menu: dynamic items at runtime
description: Replace the item list without destroying the menu. Useful for context-sensitive menus that change based on the hovered element.

title: Radial menu: debug cone visualisation
description: Enable showViz to render a canvas overlay that draws the active prediction cone and deadzone in real time — useful during development.

title: Dropdown: safe triangle submenu (v0.3)
description: Nested items open a submenu. The v0.3 safe triangle keeps it open while the cursor travels diagonally — powered by velocity prediction and speed-adaptive padding.

title: Dropdown: safe-triangle debug overlay
description: Pass debug: true to render the safe-triangle canvas overlay. The filled triangle shows the safe zone; the apex follows the cursor as you move toward the submenu.

title: SafeTriangle: utility for custom menus
description: Use the SafeTriangle class directly in your own menu system to get diagonal-movement tolerance. v0.3 adds updateApex() for continuous apex tracking.

title: MouseTracker: velocity & position
description: Track pointer position and velocity with RAF-throttled updates. Useful for custom gesture recognition or animation tied to cursor speed.
